newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lyon bans school sports as pollution rises.
newsitem.headline: Lyon bans school sports as pollution rises.

text.p: Authorities banned schools from taking part in sport in Lyon, France's second largest city, for the second successive day on Wednesday as still, cold weather raised pollution to danger levels.
The office of the prefect (government representative) said high contamination by nitrogen dioxide, due mostly to exhaust fumes from traffic, could last for two or three more days.
The prefect lifted restrictions on heating and industrial activity imposed on Tuesday.
In the Mediterranean port of Marseille, authorities also asked schools to curtail physical activities.
